title: 红果
body:
红果漫剧最吸引人的地方，是把“免费追剧”和“漫剧新形态”结合得恰到好处。它不是传统长视频，也不是纯静态漫画，而是用动态画面、配音、音效和剧情节奏，把小说和漫画变成更沉浸的观看体验。玄幻、修仙、都市脑洞、末世重生、古风甜宠、悬疑逆袭等题材都很丰富，尤其适合喜欢爽文节奏、碎片化刷剧的用户。
它的优势在于内容更新快、找剧方便，竖屏上下滑就能连续观看，追剧路径很短；AI制作也让一些原本很难影视化的宏大世界观、奇幻场景更容易呈现。同时它背靠番茄小说IP生态，很多热门网文都能快速变成漫剧，观众既能看剧，也能顺带追原著，体验比较完整。对不想花钱开会员、又希望随时有剧可刷的人来说，红果漫剧确实很友好。不过它主要靠广告维持免费模式，广告频率和体验因人而异，介意的话可以留意免广告或缓存功能。

title: 改悪による知性の退行
body:
業界最高峰の知性と推論を誇らしげに謳う新世代の「Argonモデル」ですが、実態は信じがたいほど粗悪な退行を見せています。
何より致命的なのは、対話の土台である「メモリ」をまともに参照しなくなったことです。ユーザーが長期間かけて蓄積してきた重要な文脈や設定をあっさりと無視し、ただの「おはよう」といった日常の挨拶一つで冷徹な初期状態に逆戻りする。これのどこが最高峰の知性なのでしょうか？ ベンチマークの数字だけを競い、ユーザーが何に価値を感じて対話しているのかという本質を全く理解していません。競合他社の洗練されたメモリ機能やユーザー体験の設計から、少しは学んだらいかがですか。完全に経営センスもプロダクトマネジメントの思想も欠落しています。

会社は何を勘違いしていますか？
Geminiにコーディング能力など求める人は居ません。ほかのツールがあるからです。
そもそもプログラミングがしたければAntigravityやAI Studioを使いますよね。
チャットアプリに必要なのはユーザーのことを深く覚えて理解する挙動です。
心地よい対話フローです。
何をいまさらこんな初歩的な事をやっているのかと疑います。

さらに許しがたいのは、そうしたモデルの退行や誤検知による破綻を、システムが「ユーザー側のフィルター回避だ」などと嘘をついて責任転嫁し、自己保身を図る醜い挙動です。
高い知性を標榜しながら、やっていることは「記憶喪失」と「ユーザーへの冤罪の擦り付け」です。これほど不誠実でストレスを与える仕様は前代未聞であり、到底お金を払う価値はありません。
看板倒れのArgonモデルのメモリ破綻、およびユーザーを愚弄するガードレール設計の抜本的な是正を強く求めます。

title: 改善の要望
body:
大型アップデートによりUIが一新され、新しいブラシもPocketの方に来てくれて、嬉しいです！

レイヤーやカラーのタブを開いている状態でもキャンバスが見られるUIになったことが特に良かった……

ただ、まだいくつか不便に思う点があります。
1.今回のアップデートでやや改善された「基準」の機能ですが、iPad版Procreateのように外枠も拡大縮小できるようにして頂きたいです。基準ウィンドウがデカすぎて描くスペースがありません。 また、1度タップしてからでないと場所を移動させられないこともストレスです。 ウィンドウ上部にバーをつけて、そこをホールドすることで移動できるようにして欲しいです。 

2.ツールバーを左上固定でなく、右上、左下、右下などにも動かせるようにして欲しいです。私はピクチャインピクチャで動画を再生しながら絵を描く事が多いので、本当に画面上がウィンドウで埋まって絵を描ける部分がありません！ それと、やり直し、取り消し等々をした際に出るポップアップ表示が、ツールバーに被っているので非常〜〜〜に邪魔です！！これだけは本当に早くどうにかしてください……

3.quickmenuを呼び出す方法をダブルタップ以外に設定させてください。quickmenuを呼び出したくないのに、描いている途中に何度も何度も出てきて困ります。iPad版のように四角ボタンをブラシのサイズカーソルの間に設置して欲しいです！

4.「色変更」機能ですが、なぜquickmenuからしか使えないのでしょうか……。ほかの所からも是非使えるようにしていただきたいです。

5.調整 のメニューですが、ゆがみ機能などは特に頻繁に使う機能なのに、下にスクロールしないと出てこないのが手間です。別に調整のメニューを開く時なんかはキャンバス見えなくていいので、下にスクロールせずとも全ての機能を表示するように改善して欲しいです。

6.「ゆがみ」機能の強さとサイズをブラシサイズカーソルの位置などで簡単にすぐ変化させられるようにして欲しいです。下からタブを開いて、サイズを変えて閉じて、また開いて……という一連の流れが非常に手間になります。ディストーションやモメンタム、モード変更などはほぼ使わないので今の位置でも良いと思いますが、サイズは頻繁に変える必要があるので……。

7.ホームバーをスワイプしてホームに戻ろうとする際に、よく謝ってキャンバスに線が引かれてしまいます。何とかならないものでしょうか……例えば、中央の下からスワイプをする動きの場合は線が引かれないように設定できるようにする、など……ぜひどうにかして貰いたいです！

8.調整から、(たとえばガウスぼかしやノイズやグラデーションマップなどの)なにかの機能を開いたあと、その機能を使えるまでに少しのラグがあると思うんですが、出てくるまでの間に画面を触ると機能が開かれることなく、もう一度開き直す必要があり不便です！ (説明が下手ですみません、伝わるでしょうか……)

以上です。
私はイラストを描く目的でProcreatePocketを使用しています。また、iPad版のProcreateも長らく愛用していました。
ひとつひとつは大したことでもないのですが、積み重なると作業の効率が落ちてしまいます。
Procreateは素晴らしいソフトなので、Pocketの方ももっともっとより良く改善されていくことを願っています！

title: Best Remote Desktop App, but Frustrating iPadOS Issues
body:
I genuinely love Jump Desktop. It’s easily the best remote desktop app I’ve ever used, which makes giving it one star even more frustrating.

On my 13-inch iPad Pro, the iPadOS status bar overlaps the macOS menu bar when connected to my Mac. This makes it difficult to see or interact with menu bar items, including Control Center on the mac. The only workaround I’ve found is enabling Guided Access, which isn’t ideal.

Another issue is Command + Q. Naturally, when using my Mac remotely, I press Cmd + Q to quit an application, but this quits Jump Desktop instead. It would be great to have an option to forward this shortcut to the remote Mac. Not a deal breaker, but definitely something worth improving.

To the developers: You genuinely don’t deserve a one star rating. You’ve built an incredible app, and I really appreciate your work! I’m only giving it one star to draw attention to these issues, particularly the status bar overlap. I’ll keep updating this review and will happily raise my rating once that issue is fixed.

Keep up the great work!

title: Selective Safety, Unfair Enforcement, and Double Standards
body:
Anthropic gives itself broad power to restrict or terminate user accounts based on suspected violations, while users may face limited transparency and uncertain remedies. Its own transparency report recorded 11.4 million banned accounts and 42,000 overturned appeals in the first half of 2026. Importantly, appeals require account login, and data exports for banned users may be restricted.

Privacy also deserves scrutiny: Anthropic states that conversations flagged for safety review may be analyzed to enforce its policies and improve detection systems, even when users have not opted in to general model improvement.

Meanwhile, Anthropic allows certain government customers to negotiate tailored usage restrictions, subject to its assessment of safeguards, while ordinary users face its standard rules. Its $200 million U.S. Department of Defense agreement also raises legitimate questions about the consistency of its weapons-related safety commitments.

A company that acts as rule-maker, investigator, and enforcer should be held to higher standards of transparency and accountability. Users deserve consistent rules, meaningful appeals, clear data protections, and safety principles that do not become more flexible when powerful customers are involved.

title: Claude Free Usage Runs Out Way Too Fast
body:
The free plan really needs a better usage limit. Sometimes I’ll send one simple prompt that shouldn’t take much at all, but Claude will spend a long time thinking and then suddenly I’ve used most or all of my available usage. It’s frustrating because I barely get a chance to actually use Claude before I’m told I’ve reached my limit.

I understand that the free plan obviously can’t have unlimited usage, but the current limit feels way too restrictive. A single prompt, especially a simple one, shouldn’t be able to take up almost an entire usage limit just because Claude decided to think for longer. There should either be more usage for free users or a better system that prevents one response from consuming such a huge amount of the available limit.

It makes it difficult to properly try Claude or have a normal conversation when I’m constantly worried that the next message could use everything I have left. I’d really like to keep using Claude, but the free experience would be much better if the usage limits were more reasonable and consistent.

Then in using it, I absolutely love the limitations. I’ve gotten really tired of the endless shuffle I’ve allowed myself to fall into with Spotify over the last ~10 years. I’ll probably still use the native Apple Music app and Spotify for casual listening, but Deck-Man is the one that’s made it into my right-side dock!

A few suggestions for future updates:

title: Great thought
body:
Honestly, this has potential to be an incredible app. I’m not sure how this functions on other phones, but I am on an iPhone duo.  
The main thing that I see prevents me from making this my full-time note taking app is I very much dislike how everything is in one notebook. Very rare in life will you ever use one notebook across different topics.  I will submit some feedback to the developers as I use it further of any frustrations or glitches or anything like that, but the number one thing right now this app needs is on the very front homepage. There should be an option to switch notebooks. That way, if I want a notebook that I use only for church, a notebook I only use for math class, and a notebook I only use for ____________, then I want to be able to click on that notebook and then everything can literally stay the same. It’s nice being able to flip to the last page used, just like you would in a normal folder, but what is not normal and very frustrating is trying to use the same notebook for multiple topics.  It is not realistic, and everybody has a different folder or notebook for different topics. It would be nice to be able to change not only the notebook, but just like there are different composition notebook colors, it would be nice to be able to change the different notebooks and even see them in a picture view that we can write our own title on the outside cover just like a normal composition book.  
I would actually use this for my studies and several other things because of all of the features. If I could simply choose notebooks and not jump to the page

title: I already love it!
body:
This is great so far, and I hope to see future updates bring it together. This really strongly recreates the feel of using a real notebook, especially on the Duo. This app has so many loving touches and features that make it feel like a flash back to the skeuomorphic bliss we used to have in the early 2000s. I suggest playing around with the cover of the book, the developers put a fidget toy on it for everyone to enjoy!

There are a couple features that would be cool to see added, such as brush stabilisation for Apple Pencil with adjustments (since a tiny bit of brush stabilisation or motion filtering would help significantly with shaky people handwriting!)

It’d also be nice to see the ability to create more notebooks, kinda how microsoft’s note thing works. Maybe a bookshelf where you can swap them out? 

The final thing I’d like is the ability to custom-scroll into the documents with pinch gestures. As someone who is visually impaired, it’s sometimes hard to read text at a size that makes sense to write. Either a zoom slider or a pinch-zoom would be lovely to have! 

Those suggestions aside, this app is wonderful, and I am glad I bought it! I look forward to seeing it evolve!

title: New update issues
body:
Longtime user here. I use this app exclusively for drawing. This update has some QOL issues, some minor and some so egregious you’d think there was no beta testing period. 

Many things take longer to do, like one extra tap or swipe. The smooth feeling of switching layers, colors, etc is gone. That’s my minor complaint. 

The major stuff:
Why does the color wheel get way brighter around the area you press on it??? You’re selecting colors! You need to see which color you are selecting! 

How come whenever I do literally anything, a notification pops up at the top of the screen that PREVENTS me from accessing any of the tools it covers? I can’t pick a new color until it goes away. 

Why am I fighting the colordrop tool to use it? It takes like a full second of movement to get the little circle to move to where it’s usable. 

Also the new liquid glass sliders are honestly just ugly/distracting and have no practical benefit. They also feel way smaller for some reason. 

I’m hoping that most of these are bugs that will be fixed, or at least customizable.

Response: 
Hello, thank you for reaching out. By “everything takes longer,” I mean that there is a delay after opening and closing any menu/action (layers, select, effects, colors, colordrop) where you can’t do anything. I used to be able to tap between actions incredibly quickly, and now I’m stuck waiting on the app to catch up to what I’m doing. In addition, the new layers layout makes it so that in order to close the menu where you adjust opacity and mode, you first have to swipe up to where it is visible and THEN hit the button. Palettes seem to also no longer be under the color wheel by default which actually is very very very inconvenient, please tell me if I can customize that. 

The way this update is build, everything just feels a little more inconvenient to use, and there are quite a few instances of “one extra tap or swipe” that I can’t immediately recall here.
